record.context_brief: Elementary equivalence for super McDuff factors
record.original_question: A II_1 factor N is called super McDuff when N' ∩ N^U is itself a II_1 factor. Are there two Connes embeddable super McDuff II_1 factors that are not elementarily equivalent? More strongly, are there continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable super McDuff II_1 factors?

evidence.quote: Recall that a II1 factor is super McDuff if N′ ∩ NU is a II1 factor.
Problem 18. Are there two non elementarily equivalent Connes embeddable super McDuff II1 factors N, M? Are there continuum many?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{U}$ be a free ultrafilter on $\mathbb{N}$. For a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $N$ with separable predual, let $N^{\mathcal{U}}$ denote its tracial ultrapower and $N' \cap N^{\mathcal{U}}$ its central sequence algebra. Call $N$ super McDuff if $N' \cap N^{\mathcal{U}}$ is itself a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor. Recall that $N$ is Connes embeddable if it embeds, in a trace-preserving way, into the ultrapower $\mathcal{R}^{\mathcal{U}}$ of the hyperfinite $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor $\mathcal{R}$. Two $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors $M,N$ are elementarily equivalent if they satisfy the same sentences in the continuous first-order language of tracial von Neumann algebras.

(a) Do there exist two Connes embeddable super McDuff $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors $M$ and $N$ that are not elementarily equivalent?

(b) More strongly, do there exist continuum many pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable super McDuff $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors?
artifact.category_tag: II_1 factors and model theory of operator algebras
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work introduces uniformly super McDuff II_1 factors and shows the class is closed under elementary equivalence, with the finitely generic Connes-embeddable factor being uniformly super McDuff. However, no source in the search establishes the existence of two (or continuum many) pairwise non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable super McDuff II_1 factors; the question is listed as a problem and appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Uniformly Super McDuff II_1 Factors
status_evidence.snippet: Uniformly super McDuff factors form a class closed under elementary equivalence; finitely generic Connes-embeddable factor is uniformly super McDuff.
status_evidence.claim: Related work studies a refined class of super McDuff factors but does not resolve the existence of non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable super McDuff II_1 factors.

status_evidence.title: Uniformly super McDuff II_1 factors - Mathematische Annalen
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces uniformly super McDuff property; class is stable under elementary equivalence.
status_evidence.claim: The literature on super McDuff factors does not provide multiple non-elementarily-equivalent Connes embeddable examples.
